name: lilygo-t-relay-s3
title: LilyGO T-Relay S3 + W5500 shield
notes: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, external antenna); 6-relay board. Wired only with the T-Relay S3 W5500 shield on the expansion header: SCLK 9, MOSI 13, MISO 11, CS 3, INT 12, RST 8; LilyGO's ESPHome config clocks it at 8 MHz. Wi-Fi without the shield. The LEDs hang off the relay shift register, not a GPIO. CS GPIO3 is a strapping pin. No SD slot: zones and blocking live in RAM only. Pins: T-Relay 6 ESP32-S3 schematic Rev1.1, LilyGO pin table and pin_config.h, LilyGO's ESPHome T-Relay-S3 W5500 config.
